newsitem.title: USA: HFNC sees consistent earnings improvement.
newsitem.headline: HFNC sees consistent earnings improvement.

text.p: HFNC Financial Corp said Friday it expects to see consistent improvement in its earnings in the coming quarters.

"Our core operations continue to improve, with total interest income, net interest income, loans, and asset quality all at improved levels over the same quarter last year," President, Chairman and Chief Executive H. Joe King said in a statement. "These factors and the more efficient capital level following the special distribution should produce increasing returns on shareholders' equity as we go forward."

For the third quarter, HFNC, which is the holding company for Home Federal Savings and Loan Association, reported net income of $1.87 million, or $0.12 per share versus $2.58 million, or $0.16 per share in the same period in the prior year.
"Both the current quarter and year-to-date results have borne some unusual and largely non-recurring costs," King said. "We expect consistent improvement in our earnings for the coming quarters."
